objective: Close the remaining Stage 11 semantic-preservation evidence gaps without reusing consumed holdouts, weakening thresholds, changing already-qualified evidence, or silently narrowing the twelve-class semantic contract.
globalRules: Teacher truth and detector inference remain separated.
Use development evidence for design and threshold selection; independent holdouts are one-shot qualification evidence only.
Freeze code/config/policy before independent holdout access.
A scored candidate is immutable; any retune requires a new version.
No page, filename, source-family, teacher-coordinate, or holdout-specific inference rules.
Each class must establish source-detector adequacy before source-versus-restored preservation claims.
A class failure may remain REVIEW_ONLY/REJECTED without invalidating frozen PASS evidence for other classes.
Overall Stage 11 closure requires accepted PASS evidence for every applicable class in the current contract, unless a separate explicit governance decision changes contract scope.
PR #211, production promotion and Stage 12 remain unauthorized until a separate final closure decision.

workPackages.title: Clef qualification closure
workPackages.developmentGoal: Admit or build a source-only clef detector that materially improves precision/recall over the rejected deterministic C-clef line without using teacher truth as inference input.
requiredDevelopmentEvidence: page/source-family/pooled TP/FP/FN, precision, recall and F1 against existing 213 teacher boxes
subtype classification kept separate unless independently validated
deterministic frozen raw output and runtime identity
qualificationGate: predeclare class-specific qualification thresholds and matching semantics before holdout access
use a fresh disjoint independent holdout if development-ready
freeze source-only detector output before teacher truth is opened
one-shot PASS/FAIL binding; no post-result retuning
workPackages.exit: clef=PASS or remain REVIEW_ONLY/REJECTED with evidence; do not weaken Stage 11 closure contract

workPackages.title: Core notation object and attachment evidence

classRequirements.accidental: teacher-reviewed accidental boxes; family-stratified box precision/recall; detector/cross-check must distinguish accidentals from clefs/key signatures
classRequirements.rest: teacher-reviewed rest boxes and rest-type labels; staff-relative validation
classRequirements.barline: teacher-reviewed line endpoints and barline-type labels; staff-system-aware continuity and repeat-bar checks
classRequirements.stem: teacher-reviewed stem-to-notehead graph edges; vertical strokes must be linked to noteheads rather than geometry-only classification

workPackages.executionRule: Treat each class as a separately versioned candidate and separately frozen qualification claim even if a shared detector backbone is used.
workPackages.exit: Each class independently PASS or remains unresolved; no pooled score may hide a failed class.

workPackages.title: Rhythmic/curvilinear relationship evidence

classRequirements.beam_or_flag: teacher-reviewed beam groups and flag attachments; notehead/stem graph adjacency plus oriented-stroke topology
classRequirements.tie_or_slur: teacher-reviewed curve masks plus relationship labels; endpoint proximity/arc continuity; tie-vs-slur distinction may abstain if subtype classification is not yet reliable

workPackages.exit: Relationship-level source adequacy and restored-preservation PASS per class, or explicit unresolved disposition.

workPackages.title: TAB semantic chain

classRequirements.tab_line: teacher-reviewed TAB system polygons and individual line masks; distinguish six-line TAB from standard staff before applying six-line prior
classRequirements.tab_digit: teacher-reviewed digit boxes, digit values and string-line assignment; detector restricted to validated TAB regions
classRequirements.tab_string: teacher-reviewed digit-to-string relationships; derive string identity only from ordered validated TAB lines with ambiguity abstention

workPackages.executionRule: Do not attempt tab_digit/tab_string qualification before tab_line region/topology adequacy is established.
workPackages.exit: All three TAB classes PASS independently or remain unresolved.

workPackages.title: Aggregate Stage 11 semantic closure
prerequisites: class matrix reconciled from immutable result bindings
all applicable classes have accepted PASS evidence, or a separately approved governance decision explicitly changes scope
no consumed holdout reused for tuning
no production/API behavior changed as part of qualification

smallestNextSafeAction: Start S11-C1 with a clef development/qualification design audit using the existing 213 blind teacher boxes and existing frozen development evidence only. Do not open a new holdout until a separately versioned clef candidate and prequalification policy are frozen.
